$comment: Meta's developer videos as muses for rebuilds on current Muse models. First page of https://dev.meta.ai/resources/videos/ checked Oct 26, 2026. A Load more button may hide more. Rebuilds link to Meta's videos and never copy them.

videos.title: Fine-tuning Llama models for structured image data extraction
videos.demonstrates: Customizing Llama to pull structured data out of images

rebuild.plan: Same job without fine-tuning. Muse Wonder reads the image and returns JSON that matches a schema. Upload a receipt or a form and get validated fields back.
rebuild.note: Make a tool that pulls structured fields out of photos of receipts and forms, with no fine-tuning

videos.title: Building a multimodal WhatsApp chatbot with Llama 4
videos.demonstrates: A business chatbot on WhatsApp that handles text and images

rebuild.plan: A web chat for a small business that understands photos and voice notes and can reply with images. Connecting it to WhatsApp needs a WhatsApp Business account, so the rebuild shows the web version and documents the webhook.
rebuild.note: Make a customer chat for a small shop that understands photos and voice notes

videos.title: Generating technical blogs from your docs with Llama and RAG
videos.demonstrates: Drafting blog posts from existing documentation with retrieval

rebuild.plan: Upload or paste docs and get a draft post with a header image. Most doc sets fit in Muse Wonder's 1M-token context, so there is no retrieval pipeline to build.
rebuild.note: Turn my product docs into a technical blog post with a header image

videos.title: Llama Best Practices: Unlock Rich Insights from Rich Documents
videos.demonstrates: Extracting data from PDFs, invoices and reports with the DocumentLens recipe

rebuild.plan: Upload a PDF report. Muse Wonder reads it directly and answers with tables and page references, and SAM 3.1 outlines the charts and figures on page images.
rebuild.note: Upload a PDF report and pull out the key numbers, tables and charts

videos.title: Llama Best Practices: Fine-Tuning Llama Models in the Real World

rebuild.plan: Muse Muse builds apps, not training runs, and the hosted Muse models aren't fine-tuned through the API. The rebuild checks a few-shot Muse Wonder setup against the user's labeled examples and says when fine-tuning open weights like Glimmer would still be worth it.
rebuild.note: Tell me whether my classification task still needs fine-tuning, using a few labeled examples

videos.title: Implementing Llama Protections in GenAI applications
videos.demonstrates: Safeguards for content moderation, jailbreak defense and code security

rebuild.plan: A safety check in front of a chatbot that screens prompts and replies with Muse Wonder and shows why something was blocked. Meta's open protection models stay the self-hosted option.
rebuild.note: Put a safety check in front of my chatbot that blocks jailbreaks and explains why
